labels.symptom: Proposal for a document processing SDK and self-hosted REST service.
On macOS, Chinese interface text shows as empty boxes or question marks.
labels.root_cause: No CJK fallback font is loaded for the UI on macOS.

labels.symptom: Automation cannot extract text inside a bounding box or split documents at marker text.
Signed PDFs use only the local clock for the signing time because there is no timestamp server option.
The print dialog does not list any printers and only offers Save as PDF.
There is no option to change the page background and text colours or use inverted reading presets.
On Linux the 'Use system setting' theme option ignores the desktop's dark/light mode and keeps the last theme.
labels.root_cause: System theme detection does not work on Linux.

labels.symptom: Custom TrueType fonts cannot be used or embedded in documents.
On macOS, Cmd+ and Cmd- zoom the whole interface instead of the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The UI framework's built-in zoom shortcuts take the key presses before the canvas zoom command gets them.

labels.symptom: Middle-click autoscroll is not supported.
On Windows, dragging the window around is laggy.
The Flatpak build crashes at startup on GNOME Wayland with an NVIDIA plus AMD integrated GPU because the NVIDIA GPU is not found.
labels.root_cause: Under native Wayland in the Flatpak sandbox, wgpu enumerates only the iGPU and llvmpipe, and the surface is unsupported by the chosen adapter.
bug_markers: The surface isn't supported by this adapter

labels.symptom: The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: Installing the desktop app and configuring an agent are separate manual steps with no in-app help.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Each platform's package handles the CLI differently, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: The app cannot be installed or upgraded through winget.
Form fields cannot be multi-selected to delete or edit them together.
The Windows MSI installer reports 'not responding' and installs only after clicking Retry several times.
The app inside the macOS release dmg fails strict codesign verification because of Finder information detritus.
labels.root_cause: Empty com.apple.FinderInfo extended attributes on bundle resources are not removed before signing.

labels.symptom: Text editing mode has no save or exit control, and each word is a separate text box, so paragraph edits break the layout.
PDFs that are permission-restricted or already signed cannot be signed without breaking the earlier signatures.
labels.root_cause: Encrypted documents are refused, and saves rewrite the whole file instead of appending an incremental update.

labels.symptom: Simplified Chinese support is poor: parts of the interface are untranslated or display incorrectly.
On macOS, Save As to a mounted network or encrypted volume fails, and a crash report appears after quitting.
There is no Tags panel for checking or adding accessibility tags to a document.
Simplified Chinese interface text shows as empty boxes (tofu).
labels.root_cause: The bundled interface fonts have no Simplified Chinese glyphs (no Droid Sans Fallback).

labels.symptom: Scrolling with the mouse wheel is very slow.
Dropdown fields in XML/XFA form documents don't display or behave like they should.
The app cannot update itself; new versions must be downloaded by hand.
On Wayland, after Ctrl+scroll zooming, releasing Ctrl leaves the mouse wheel stuck zooming instead of scrolling.
labels.root_cause: The Ctrl key release event is missed, so the modifier state stays stuck on Wayland.

labels.symptom: Mouse-wheel and trackpad scrolling through documents feels slower than in other viewers.
labels.root_cause: Too little distance is scrolled per wheel step.

labels.symptom: Password-protected PDFs cannot be opened for editing because there is no way to enter the password.
In the Simplified Chinese interface many characters show as garbled or missing glyphs.
labels.root_cause: Likely no CJK fallback font is loaded for the UI.

labels.symptom: Redacted added text can still be recovered from the saved file.
labels.root_cause: Redaction copied the content stream dictionary unchanged, so its /PCAdded entry kept the original text.

labels.symptom: CI fails on clippy 1.99 with a chunks_exact_to_as_chunks lint error.
labels.root_cause: A new clippy lint denies chunks_exact with a constant size.

labels.symptom: Choosing Organize Pages leaves the full-size document on screen instead of showing a page thumbnail overview.
Choosing 100% interface size still draws at the system's display scale, such as 200%.
labels.root_cause: The chosen interface size was multiplied by the display scale instead of being absolute.

labels.symptom: A source build says text recognition isn't installed because its models are missing.
labels.root_cause: The README build instructions don't mention fetching the OCR models.

labels.symptom: On Windows, printing scales pages down to about 76%, opens a console window and freezes the interface.
labels.root_cause: Pages were drawn inside .NET's default margins, and PowerShell spooling ran on the UI thread without CREATE_NO_WINDOW.

labels.symptom: On macOS in a language other than English, the Print dialog lists no printers.
labels.root_cause: macOS CUPS lpstat output follows the UI language unless SOFTWARE is set, so the English-only parser matched nothing.

labels.symptom: Opening a document walks the form fields twice.
labels.root_cause: fields() and adopted_page_fields() each enumerated the form tree.

labels.symptom: Scanned documents get English-only OCR, with no automatic deskew or border cropping.
The Save button's tooltip and accessible name show an internal tag like "(M4)" instead of its keyboard shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The tooltip was a hardcoded literal instead of a platform-aware shortcut label.

labels.symptom: Printing on Windows shrinks pages into default margins and uses the wrong binding edge for duplex.
labels.root_cause: The app's own Windows print backend refit sheets into margins and reversed the duplex binding edges.

labels.symptom: Opening or refreshing a document scans its pages twice.
labels.root_cause: Two separate page/content scans ran back to back.

labels.symptom: On Linux the System theme setting stays light when the desktop is in dark mode.
labels.root_cause: The numeric XDG portal color-scheme value was not read, and results from the worker thread did not wake an idle window to repaint.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Some Traditional Chinese interface terms are wrong or reverse their meaning.
labels.root_cause: Mistranslated catalog entries.

labels.symptom: Some Italian interface labels are mistranslated, read as the wrong part of speech, or have wrong grammatical agreement.
labels.root_cause: The Italian translations were literal and ignored context and agreement.

labels.symptom: Enhancing a camera image does not detect the document's edges automatically.
Text created through automation silently turns Korean, CJK or emoji characters into question marks.
labels.root_cause: Characters outside WinAnsiEncoding were replaced with '?' instead of being refused with an error.

labels.symptom: Combine files accepts only PDFs, not images or text files.
Hindi/Devanagari text shows as boxes or with misplaced vowel signs while editing.
labels.root_cause: The UI font fallback only probed for Arabic and had no Devanagari system fallback font, and visual-order pre-base matras were not reordered.

labels.symptom: Photographed pages keep colour casts and shadows after they are enhanced.
Links and scripts in a document open web addresses or system handlers without asking.
labels.root_cause: Every document URL path called open_url directly, with no confirmation and no scheme allowlist.

labels.symptom: Double-click or triple-click text selection only highlights after the mouse button is released, not when it is pressed.
labels.root_cause: Multi-click selection used egui's double_clicked()/triple_clicked(), which fire on release.

labels.symptom: The app icon uses the old animal artwork instead of the letter monogram.
On some Windows NVIDIA systems the app exits at startup before a window appears, instead of falling back to OpenGL.
labels.root_cause: A wgpu pipeline creation failure during renderer setup panicked through the default error handler instead of returning an error to the OpenGL fallback.

labels.symptom: Filled form fields show the wrong characters, such as curly apostrophes or dashes, after saving.
labels.root_cause: Appearances wrote WinAnsi bytes into a reused font that has a custom encoding or is a subset.

labels.symptom: In a one-field form, typing a value, pressing Tab and then saving brings back the old value.
labels.root_cause: The editor that gets focus opens before the queued edit is accepted, so it holds an old draft.

labels.symptom: A missing, empty or repeated --root option on the command line can leave tools unconfined or confined to the wrong folder.
labels.root_cause: The CLI did not validate --root arguments before dispatching scripts, tools or the MCP server.

labels.symptom: Moving or enlarging a clipped image in a PDF cuts it off at its original rectangle.
labels.root_cause: The image edit wrapped only the Do operator in a transform, leaving the preceding clip rectangle untransformed.

labels.symptom: On Linux desktops with two GPUs, the window stays black or the app panics at startup with 'The surface isn't supported by this adapter'.
labels.root_cause: The forced low-power GPU preference picked the integrated GPU, which cannot present to monitors connected to the discrete GPU.

labels.symptom: OCR in the standalone command-line archive does not work until its models are installed separately.
labels.root_cause: The CLI packaging scripts did not copy the staged OCR models into the archive.

labels.symptom: Dragging a text box over another and moving it again deletes text.
labels.root_cause: The paragraph drag rewrote unchanged text and deleted overlapping text.

labels.symptom: The reopen-last-files preference ignores the macOS setting to keep windows when quitting.
labels.root_cause: The NSQuitAlwaysKeepsWindows system setting was not read at first launch.

labels.symptom: Choosing a border color also changes the fill color palette in field properties.
labels.root_cause: Two color palettes shared the same egui Grid ID.

labels.symptom: On macOS the window's traffic-light buttons are not vertically centred in the top tab strip or title bar.
labels.root_cause: With a hidden system title bar, AppKit centres the traffic lights in a 28 pt band, but the custom tab strip was 38 pt tall.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Turkish.
Scans in Fraktur or handwritten Kurrent are recognised poorly because only the modern OCR model is used.
The interface language doesn't follow the system language.
labels.root_cause: Translations were hard-coded tables, not per-language catalogs with an auto default.

labels.symptom: Some PDF pages with gradient fades take several seconds each to render.
labels.root_cause: Axial and radial shadings were evaluated per pixel on one thread instead of as native gradients.

labels.symptom: Scan folders cannot be processed automatically while the editor is closed.
Progress and parity docs list already-fixed issues as open.
labels.root_cause: Docs were not refreshed after a batch of fixes merged.

labels.symptom: Page counts on the home/recent documents screen use the wrong plural form in languages like Polish (e.g. "1 strony").
labels.root_cause: A fixed translated word was used instead of the plural-aware translation helper.

labels.symptom: With Czech selected, most of the interface still shows in English.
labels.root_cause: The Czech translation catalog covered only a small subset of interface keys.

labels.symptom: Collapsing or resizing a sidebar makes the document jump away from the current reading position.
labels.root_cause: After the fit zoom changed, the scroll area kept its old absolute scroll offset.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Extracted text scrambles words on a line when the right-hand text is drawn first, e.g. '20.0 19.4' becomes '20. 019.4'.
labels.root_cause: Word-gap spaces were placed by content-stream drawing order instead of by position on the line.

labels.symptom: A watermark cannot be offset from the page centre.
labels.root_cause: The offset existed internally but neither the dialog nor the tool exposed it.

labels.symptom: Form scripts sometimes get abandoned on open under load, which disables all of the form's scripts.
labels.root_cause: The script time limit started before the engine thread and context were created, so setup time counted against the 1 s limit.

labels.symptom: There is no place in Preferences to see and choose light and dark themes.
labels.root_cause: The app had only a theme toggle button with no theme picker.

labels.symptom: The Open dialog lets you pick only one file, while drag and drop opens several.
labels.root_cause: The native file picker is called without multiple selection turned on.

labels.symptom: On Linux the launcher is not matched to the open window, and the busy cursor keeps spinning after launch until it times out.
labels.root_cause: StartupWMClass in the .desktop file did not match the window's app id set through with_app_id.

labels.symptom: On Linux hybrid-GPU laptops whose Wayland compositor runs on the discrete GPU, the window opens empty with no error.
labels.root_cause: The adapter was picked as the integrated GPU driving the built-in panel instead of the GPU the compositor draws with, so the frames it rendered were never shown.

labels.symptom: In Brazilian Portuguese the date picker shows month names capitalised, like "12 de Janeiro de 2026".
labels.root_cause: The pt-BR catalog had no context-specific lowercase month rows for calendar dates.

labels.symptom: There are only a few built-in themes, and custom themes cannot be created or managed from scripts.
The interface is not available in Slovenian.
On Linux, scrolling with the mouse wheel is slow and spinning the wheel faster doesn't speed it up.
labels.root_cause: Each wheel notch moved a fixed step with no acceleration for fast notches.

labels.symptom: Importing a large signature image fails without saying which size limit it exceeds.
labels.root_cause: The decoder's DimensionError bypasses the app's detailed size message.

labels.symptom: Dynamic XFA forms appear as one page with content missing or cut off.
labels.root_cause: Wrapped single-block subforms taller than a content area were not split across pages.

labels.symptom: Redacted content stays in the saved file, and untrusted input is not handled safely.
labels.root_cause: Redacted XObjects keep their resource names, so the originals remain in the file; signature validation and input parsing also had gaps.

labels.symptom: There were no repository rules or lint settings to keep panics and unsafe code out.
There is no check for redactions that only cover text with boxes while the text is still extractable.
Choosing a tool with no document open only shows "Open a document first" instead of asking for a file.
The Windows and macOS installers show only English, whatever the system language.
On Windows, a powershell.exe placed next to a portable copy of the app runs in place of the real PowerShell when printing.
labels.root_cause: Command::new with the bare name 'powershell' searches the executable's own directory before System32.

labels.symptom: Annotation tools can't be used properly with touch or a pen because they rely on hover.
Dialogs have cramped margins, tall dialogs get cut off with no scrolling, and fields and radio buttons are hard to see.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs used no shared modal frame or scrolling, and widget edges had too little contrast.

labels.symptom: On Linux, clicking the middle mouse button does not start autoscroll.
A photographed handwritten signature can't be cleanly turned into a signature; paper and shadows stay visible.
Characters the standard fonts cannot draw are silently written as question marks.
labels.root_cause: Generated text uses WinAnsi Helvetica and replaced unsupported characters without reporting.

labels.symptom: Comment text with line breaks saved as CR shows its paragraphs run together on one line.
labels.root_cause: egui only breaks lines at LF, and CR/CRLF in comment contents were not normalised to LF.

labels.symptom: Memory grows without bound while editing or browsing large documents, and typing in big forms is slow.
labels.root_cause: Object and text-layer caches were unbounded and form refresh did an O(F^2) field lookup.

labels.symptom: In-place text editing splits text into small fragments over a duplicate of the text, and cropped images show selection boxes for their hidden area.
labels.root_cause: Editing worked on raw source runs, and image bounds ignored clipping.

labels.symptom: Pages with thousands of images open slowly, hang at high zoom, and can crash.
labels.root_cause: Every tile decodes and rasterizes all images, even ones outside the tile, with no decode cache.

labels.symptom: No Hebrew right-to-left interface language is available.
The interface can't be shown in Simplified Chinese, and translated labels can deadlock.
labels.root_cause: Translations were looked up inside widget_info closures that run under egui's context write lock.

labels.symptom: Two-page view always scrolls continuously and cannot show one spread at a time.
labels.root_cause: Continuous scrolling was tied to the page column mode.

labels.symptom: Hovering clickable tabs or buttons shows a text I-beam cursor instead of a pointing hand.
labels.root_cause: Clickable controls were built from selectable egui labels.

labels.symptom: On large documents every edit freezes the UI for over a second.
labels.root_cause: Each content edit triggered a full synchronous refresh that rebuilt all annotation appearances.

labels.symptom: Print offers no architectural or large paper sizes and doesn't show the PDF scale.
Uploading a large image as a signature fails with a confusing error.
labels.root_cause: Images over 4096px or 4MP were rejected instead of scaled down.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app is missing from Explorer's Open with list after install until sign-out.
labels.root_cause: The installer does not notify Explorer of file association changes via SHChangeNotify.

labels.symptom: Converting a PDF invoice to Word adds fake table borders and pushes content onto extra pages.
labels.root_cause: Export turned borderless aligned fields into bordered tables and placed watermarks in the body text flow.

labels.symptom: A PDF with only a permissions password can't be edited, and there's nowhere to type the password.
labels.root_cause: A password was asked for only when the file couldn't be opened without one.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+A does not select all pages in the page organizer.
Rendered pages are missing their last partial row and column of pixels.
labels.root_cause: The rasteriser floored fractional scaled page sizes instead of rounding up.

labels.symptom: Form field detection is hard to find, and Delete removes only one of several selected fields.
labels.root_cause: Detection had no panel entry, and Delete acted on a single field.

labels.symptom: Form check boxes and radio buttons cannot use different mark styles.
Form fields with deeply nested scripts or huge dates crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The form script parser and evaluator had no depth limit, and date math overflowed i32.

labels.symptom: Docs are outdated, link to private standards, and reference a missing releasing guide.
labels.root_cause: Documentation fell out of sync with the shipped code and workflows.

labels.symptom: Dynamic XFA forms open as a single 'requires Adobe Reader' placeholder page.
labels.root_cause: There was no XFA template layout support.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app cannot be chosen as the default program for its file type; Windows says the app can't run on this PC.
labels.root_cause: The MSI registered no file association/ProgID, leaving only an advertised shortcut that Windows can't use as a handler.

labels.symptom: Opening a document with a deeply nested form script makes the app abort.
labels.root_cause: The boa JS engine recurses without a depth limit and overflows the stack.

labels.symptom: Automation tools that write files are advertised to MCP clients as read-only.
labels.root_cause: The tool table flagged tools that overwrite files as read-only and not destructive.

labels.symptom: The command-line text extraction exits with success even when a selected page could not be read.
labels.root_cause: Per-page errors were printed to stderr but did not change the exit status.

labels.symptom: An unexpected internal error in an edit, open, save or menu command crashes the whole app and loses work.
labels.root_cause: There was no catch_unwind guard around commands and file operations.

labels.symptom: Most of the interface is untranslated in Traditional Chinese, and there is no Preferences entry when no document is open.
Most dialogs and messages stay in English when Japanese is selected.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese table covered only 49 core labels.

labels.symptom: Valid signatures from DocuSign and similar services are reported as wrong or tampered.
labels.root_cause: A strict DER reader rejected BER encodings, and later DSS changes were classified too broadly.

labels.symptom: On macOS, opening a file dialog and then clicking in the window makes the app abort.
labels.root_cause: A blocking rfd modal dialog runs a nested run loop inside winit's event handler, so winit re-enters and panics in a context that can't unwind.

labels.symptom: Malformed encrypted files could crash the app during decryption.
labels.root_cause: expect("16 bytes") on AES block slicing.

labels.symptom: In text edit mode, text boxes appear off the page on files split across several content streams.
labels.root_cause: Each content stream was read with a fresh graphics state instead of carrying it over from the previous stream.

labels.symptom: Check boxes printed on flat forms can't be ticked by simply clicking them.
Redacted text can still be extracted from some files, even though Verify reports the page clean.
labels.root_cause: Each content-stream piece was parsed on its own, so operators split across pieces were cut off from their operands.

labels.symptom: Editing a text line makes the following text vanish and leaves a corrupt page.
labels.root_cause: The edited content-stream piece was re-serialised from parsed operators, which dropped tokens shared with neighbouring pieces.

labels.symptom: Scripts, optimization or accessibility tagging could panic on unusual documents.
labels.root_cause: expect calls on the graphics-state stack, the font map and the script host.

labels.symptom: Applying redactions may leave content behind without reporting what was checked.
A script or agent confined with --root can learn which outside paths exist and can write files outside the root.
labels.root_cause: Paths were canonicalized before the containment check, and script output paths were not confined at all.

labels.symptom: Brazilian Portuguese isn't available as an interface language.
Malformed certificate files or signatures could crash the app.
labels.root_cause: expect and unreachable calls while parsing PKCS#12 and X.509.

labels.symptom: There is no preference for the workspace mode used when opening new documents.
The app was renamed; settings saved under the old name are migrated.
On macOS the app is greyed out under Open With, and a forced open says it cannot open the file format.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist declared the document type only by extension and MIME type, without LSItemContentTypes UTIs.

labels.symptom: A saved signature can't be changed or removed, and long typed names get clipped.
labels.root_cause: There was no UI to edit saved signatures, and signature outlines were capped by the single-glyph outline limit.

labels.symptom: Importing outlines or looking up bookmarks and page labels could panic.
labels.root_cause: expect and unreachable calls in the organize crate.

labels.symptom: Some checkboxes and radio buttons in forms are not drawn.
labels.root_cause: The vendored PDF parser's stream recovery misread an indirect appearance state dictionary as the next stream in the file.

labels.symptom: Adds an AI assistant that works with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint the user chooses.
The Windows MSI installer has no desktop shortcut option, no Start Menu entry shows up, and nothing confirms that setup finished.
labels.root_cause: The MSI used an advertised Start Menu shortcut, had no desktop shortcut component and had no completion dialog.

labels.symptom: Extracting page text or reading named destinations could panic on unusual documents.
labels.root_cause: expect and unreachable calls in text reading order and inspect.

labels.symptom: Clicking a form button that should show or hide a field does nothing, and hidden fields can still be clicked.
labels.root_cause: The Hide action was not parsed or run, and hidden widgets were still hit-tested.

labels.symptom: The About window has no contributor or model credits.
Printing several pages per sheet offers no cut-and-stack order, and very large n-up grids could crash.
labels.root_cause: N-up grid multiplication was unchecked and could overflow and panic.

labels.symptom: The Windows ARM64 smoke test fails because its page render is written to a doubled path.
labels.root_cause: Output paths now resolve inside --root, but the workflow still put the root folder in the path, so it was doubled.

labels.symptom: Deleted pages, including their content, stay in the saved file when a bookmark, link or form field still points at them.
labels.root_cause: Deleting a page only took it out of the page tree and left other references to the page object in place.

labels.symptom: A scoped view refresh could hit an unreachable panic.
labels.root_cause: Scope::Full was marked unreachable!.

labels.symptom: The packaging lint CI job fails because actionlint rejects the macos-release runner label.
labels.root_cause: actionlint.yaml did not declare the org's custom macos-release larger-runner label.

labels.symptom: Piping command-line output into head or grep -q makes the tool panic and exit with status 101.
labels.root_cause: println! panics on a broken pipe when the reader closes stdout early.

labels.symptom: Creating a PDF from images gives no way to choose the DPI or page size.
The save-changes prompt grows past the screen for a long file name, hiding its message and buttons.
labels.root_cause: egui's Modal sizes to its content, and the title label wasn't wrapped to the dialog width.

labels.symptom: There are no tools to measure distance, perimeter or area on a drawing.
With Simplified Chinese selected, some prompts and labels still appear in English.
labels.root_cause: The Simplified Chinese catalog had missing entries.

labels.symptom: Malformed automation or MCP tool arguments could crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The automation tools used expect and unreachable on untrusted input.

labels.symptom: When following the system theme, the theme toggle is overwritten on the next frame, and the menus show duplicate theme controls.
labels.root_cause: The toolbar and the menus used separate theme state, and the system mode re-applied the resolved theme every frame.

labels.symptom: On Windows with a Chinese display language, the UI opens in English when the language is set to Auto.
labels.root_cause: Auto language detection only read the LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG environment variables and never asked Windows for its display language.

labels.symptom: Some UI actions could crash the app on unexpected state instead of being ignored.
labels.root_cause: The UI used expect and unreachable calls, and the Windows build.rs panicked.

labels.symptom: File picker tests fail intermittently on slow CI runners.
labels.root_cause: The tests polled for 1 s for a panicking worker's drop guard instead of joining the thread.

labels.symptom: Contributor instructions point to plan files that are missing from the repository.
labels.root_cause: The plan folder is gitignored, so it isn't in a clone.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app isn't offered for its file type in Open With, and opening a file with it from Finder fails.
labels.root_cause: The bundle declared the document type only by extension and MIME type, not by UTI.

labels.symptom: A mistyped command-line option is ignored silently, and the command writes an unchanged file and reports success.
labels.root_cause: The argument loop's catch-all arm skipped unknown options.

labels.symptom: Each part of a split document is almost as large as the original because it keeps every image.
labels.root_cause: Extracted pages kept the whole shared resource dictionary, including XObjects they never draw.

labels.symptom: Earlier fixes (About credits, a clean exit on a closed pipe, the release runner) disappeared after a merge.
labels.root_cause: A squash merge carried an old tree and reverted commits already on main.

labels.symptom: Creating a document could panic on an unexpected page tree.
labels.root_cause: add_page used expect.

labels.symptom: XFA form scripts do not run, so totals, add-row buttons, visibility and validation don't work.
Extracting text from a password-protected PDF on the command line prints nothing and exits successfully.
labels.root_cause: A failed document open was stored as None and looked like zero pages, so no error was raised.

labels.symptom: There are no install instructions for Gentoo users.
The desktop app writes no log anywhere, so users launching from a menu or Dock have nothing to attach to bug reports.
labels.root_cause: The desktop binary never installs a logger, so log records and panic reports are thrown away.

labels.symptom: Crates already free of panics had nothing to stop new unwrap or expect calls from being added.
The mouse wheel doesn't turn pages in single-page view, and there's no page display menu.
Annotation and link rectangles reported by automation are in the wrong coordinate system.
labels.root_cause: doc_info returned raw PDF user-space rects instead of displayed-page coordinates.

labels.symptom: Protecting a document with only an open password silently ignores the copy and edit restrictions.
labels.root_cause: Permissions are only enforced with an owner password, and the tool didn't say so or refuse the call.

labels.symptom: Fit page with mixed page sizes had no regression test.
A GUI launch on Windows can crash or abort when logging fails or a panic occurs.
labels.root_cause: eprintln! panics when standard error is a broken pipe, which happens for GUI processes.

labels.symptom: Internal expect calls in edit and annotation export code could crash the app.
labels.root_cause: Production code used expect instead of handling missing values.

labels.symptom: The interface could not be shown in Spanish.
Turns on clippy::pedantic for the whole workspace and clears all of its warnings.
Note and attachment icons added through automation land one icon-width off on rotated pages.
labels.root_cause: The icon's top-left was converted as a single point, not as a rectangle, so rotation picked the wrong corner.

labels.symptom: Rendering to a .png file from the command line writes a PAM file that no image viewer can open.
labels.root_cause: The CLI always wrote a netpbm PAM stream, whatever the output file extension.

labels.symptom: Splitting from the command line fails with an OS error when the output folder doesn't exist.
labels.root_cause: The CLI wrote output files without first creating the output directory.

labels.symptom: Switching between open document tabs loses each document's scroll position.
labels.root_cause: The document view's egui ScrollArea had no per-document id, so all tabs shared one scroll offset.

labels.symptom: Frame-budget performance tests fail now and then on CI runners.
labels.root_cause: Perf tests ran in parallel on small CI runners and took a single noisy measurement.

labels.symptom: Arrow keys and Page Up/Down do not move through a scrolling document.
labels.root_cause: egui ScrollArea has no keyboard scrolling and shortcuts only handled single-page view.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app crashes if you click in the window while a Save or other file dialog is open.
labels.root_cause: Blocking rfd::FileDialog runs a nested NSSavePanel modal loop inside winit's event handler, causing panic_cannot_unwind.

labels.symptom: Adds a contributor credit.
In two-page view with a cover page, Ctrl+Page Down stops after the cover or skips spreads.
labels.root_cause: Current page was chosen by visible height with rounding ties among fully visible pages.

labels.symptom: CLI tests fail at random.
labels.root_cause: Tests running in parallel shared the same temp files.

labels.symptom: Malformed PDF input makes the app allocate gigabytes of memory, and the nightly fuzz job is killed by running out of memory.
labels.root_cause: Buffer sizes for PNG predictor rows, tiling-pattern cells and xref streams were taken from untrusted input without limits.

labels.symptom: Inserting or replacing pages from a file picker changes whichever document is active when the read finishes, not the one it was started on.
labels.root_cause: Web file requests did not record the target document.

labels.symptom: Malformed annotation appearances can send NaN or infinite coordinates to rendering.
labels.root_cause: Divide by zero when an appearance BBox or Matrix is degenerate.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window with no layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG had no background image or Finder layout.

labels.symptom: Highlight annotations without an appearance stream are invisible.
labels.root_cause: Vendored interpreter only drew annotations via /AP /N appearance streams.

labels.symptom: There are no Flatpak builds and AppImages don't auto-update.
PDFs with malformed font width tables render overlapping glyphs, substitute the wrong font, or exhaust memory and crash.
labels.root_cause: read_widths pushed one entry per code below a huge /FirstChar, truncated at bad entries, and failed the whole font on bad ranges.

labels.symptom: Some annotation appearances draw shifted, partly outside their rectangle.
labels.root_cause: The vendored interpreter's appearance matrix translation term left out the scale factor.

labels.symptom: Saving while still typing in a form field leaves the typed text out of the saved file.
labels.root_cause: A field's draft text was committed only on Enter, Tab or losing focus, after save shortcuts had already run.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app and lists macOS before Windows.
The single-letter tool shortcuts shown in toolbar tooltips do nothing.
labels.root_cause: No key handler was wired up for the shortcuts the tooltips advertised.

labels.symptom: Arabic or Hebrew file names show as boxes or in the wrong word order in tabs and recent-file lists.
labels.root_cause: The UI font stack had no Arabic face and egui laid out right-to-left runs in logical order.

labels.symptom: Find misses text laid out vertically when the page also has horizontal text.
labels.root_cause: Text extraction ignored the CMap vertical writing mode and grouped vertical columns as horizontal lines.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed PDF with huge image sizes uses gigabytes of memory or crashes.
labels.root_cause: Image masks and CCITT line buffers were allocated from untrusted size fields with no limit.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in French.
labels.root_cause: No French UI catalog existed.

labels.symptom: Clicking a link or button that should show or hide document layers does nothing or shows an unsupported-action message.
labels.root_cause: Set-layer-visibility (SetOCGState) actions were not implemented for links and push buttons.
bug_markers: SetOCGState actions run in the JavaScript engine (M6)

labels.symptom: You can't select several pages in the page thumbnails and print just those.
A valid .p12 certificate file is rejected as not a PKCS #12 file.
labels.root_cause: The parser required clean DER and refused files with trailing whitespace, PEM armour or base64 encoding.

labels.symptom: The space audit reports added images as content streams.
labels.root_cause: Content streams were claimed before resources, so images they referenced were counted as content.

labels.symptom: Malformed PDFs with huge predictor columns or stroke widths make the app abort while allocating memory.
labels.root_cause: The vendored hayro code overflowed when computing predictor row widths and placed no limit on stroke widths.

labels.symptom: XFA forms written in FormCalc do not calculate, validate or respond to buttons.
labels.root_cause: There was no FormCalc interpreter.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, a file named in the startup URL that fails to load shows only the welcome screen, with no error message.
labels.root_cause: The startup fetch failure was logged only to the developer console.

labels.symptom: On Windows, certificates in the personal certificate store do not appear for digital signing.
labels.root_cause: Signing only supported file-based IDs and the macOS Keychain.

labels.symptom: An automation request to close a clean document succeeds even when the discard flag is malformed.
labels.root_cause: doc_close validated discard_changes only for dirty documents.

labels.symptom: Editing a paragraph turns fullwidth ideographic spaces into normal spaces and drops leading indentation.
labels.root_cause: Paragraph normalization and trimming treated U+3000 as ordinary whitespace.

labels.symptom: On hybrid-graphics laptops text becomes garbled after screen lock or suspend, and the save-changes dialog ignores Enter and Escape.
labels.root_cause: egui-wgpu defaults to the high-performance discrete GPU, whose NVIDIA driver can corrupt textures across suspend; also the canvas consumed Escape and command shortcuts kept running under the modal dialog.

labels.symptom: The Windows MSI can be forced into a per-user install that leaves machine-wide file associations pointing into one user's profile, and the progress text can go blank during install.
labels.root_cause: The per-machine MSI did not reject per-user scope overrides, and an empty ActionText event cleared the progress message.

labels.symptom: With the interface in Simplified Chinese, the About credits tabs and some multiline instructions still show in English.
labels.root_cause: Some strings in the credits and multiline literals were missing from the catalog and from the coverage check.

labels.symptom: In a folder other users can write to, saving a file could overwrite some other file through a planted link.
labels.root_cause: Atomic saves wrote to a fixed, predictable temp file name with fs::write, which follows symbolic links and writes through hard links.

labels.symptom: There is no way to check from inside the app whether a newer release is available.
Combining files uses a cramped modal and only shows problems such as protected files after pressing Combine.
With a very long file name, the unsaved-changes prompt grows beyond the window and its buttons go off-screen.
labels.root_cause: The save prompt title showed the full document name without shortening.

labels.symptom: The File menu has no Open Recent submenu, even though a recent-files list exists.
The Windows portable zip still writes settings and recovery files to AppData instead of beside the exe.
labels.root_cause: The app had no portable mode and the zip did not include a portable.txt marker.

labels.symptom: In the Bookmarks panel, long page labels overlap the bookmark titles.
labels.root_cause: The page label was painted with no width limit, while the title reserved a fixed 36 px for it.

labels.symptom: Combining documents through automation with an invalid page selector silently includes every page.
labels.root_cause: Page selectors that were not strings were treated as null.

labels.symptom: Version bump to 0.2.0.
Core crates have no README.
Combining, extracting or splitting PDF/X pages produces a file that is no longer PDF/X.
labels.root_cause: Output intents and PDF/X identification were not copied into the new document.

labels.symptom: Fill & Sign cannot use an existing image file as a signature.
Clicking an email link in a document can draft a message that attaches a local file, and international link hosts look like real domains.
labels.root_cause: mailto links were passed on without removing attach/insert parameters, and hosts were not shown in punycode.

labels.symptom: Another local user can read or replace files the app writes to a shared temp folder by planting symlinks.
labels.root_cause: Temp files went to predictable paths created with create_dir_all and fs::write, which follow symlinks planted by other users.

labels.symptom: Corpus tests pass on a missing or changed test checkout.
labels.root_cause: The pdf.js corpus was cloned at HEAD without a pin or a hash check, and the tests returned early when it was missing.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Telugu, and Telugu script has no bundled font.
Malformed or hostile automation tool arguments could crash the server or reach files outside the allowed root.
labels.root_cause: Tool argument checks only validated shape, not types or ranges, and nothing tested this.

labels.symptom: The MCP server lists every tool, which fills an agent's context with a very large tool list.
Resizing or moving an image signature only updates the frame, with the image jumping on release.

labels.root_cause: Save staging helper was duplicated in two crates.

labels.symptom: Generated text in standard PDF fonts is measured with the wrong widths, so layout and redaction are off.
labels.root_cause: Advance widths were estimated by character class, not taken from the real standard-14 metrics.

labels.symptom: A PDF can't be created directly from a scanner.
Editing page text clips replacement text, leaves old text visible, loses the original font style and turns Japanese characters into question marks.
labels.root_cause: Editor boxes stayed fixed to the original bounds and replacement text was encoded only as WinAnsi.

labels.symptom: Clippy with -D warnings fails on newer Rust due to chunks_exact with a constant size.
labels.root_cause: Rust 1.99 clippy lint chunks_exact_to_as_chunks rejects chunks_exact(4).

labels.symptom: Creating a PDF from multiple files was not available.
Clipped shapes, gradients and images in PDFs spill across the page.
labels.root_cause: A pending clip was applied only on the n operator, not after other path-painting operators.

labels.symptom: The document looks blurry at some zoom levels, especially on high-DPI displays.
labels.root_cause: The raster was rendered at a rounded scale and placed at non-pixel-aligned positions, so the GPU resampled it linearly.

labels.symptom: Adds a contributor credit entry.
Default comment styles and page display choices are lost after restarting.
labels.root_cause: These settings were not saved.

labels.symptom: A third click on text clears the selection instead of selecting the line.
labels.root_cause: egui counts only up to triple clicks, and the viewer handled only double clicks.

labels.symptom: Japanese text in fonts the document doesn't embed is not drawn.
labels.root_cause: No font resolver was installed, so the fallback was a Latin font with no Japanese glyphs.

labels.symptom: A long operation freezes the window, which looks like a crash or triggers a 'not responding' dialog.
labels.root_cause: Heavy work ran on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Annotations without an appearance stream aren't drawn.
labels.root_cause: The renderer only drew Highlight annotations when /AP was missing.

labels.symptom: Required radio buttons get square red borders, and the Highlight fields setting is not remembered.
Ink annotations show as straight zig-zag segments instead of smooth curves.
labels.root_cause: The appearance builder joined ink points with straight lines instead of a spline.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Russian translation.
Long toast messages overflow the window, and the search shortcut hint shows the wrong key on Linux.
labels.root_cause: Toast width wasn't limited to the viewport, and the shortcut hint wasn't formatted for the platform.

labels.symptom: The app contacts GitHub at startup to check for updates.
labels.root_cause: An optional update check ran on the first frame.

labels.symptom: On Linux the app can't become the default handler in GNOME Files, and double-clicking a file opens another app.
labels.root_cause: The .desktop Exec line used %F instead of %u, and the app did not decode file:// URI arguments.

labels.symptom: There is no way to pin folders on Home and see their newest files.
Signatures that use less common algorithms cannot be validated.
Edited Japanese text reports an empty font name when inspected.
labels.root_cause: Generated Type 3 fonts had no BaseFont, and inspection read only BaseFont.

labels.symptom: Comment replies and review statuses come back as separate top-level comments after an FDF export and import.
labels.root_cause: FDF export removed /IRT references without replacing them with links to objects inside the FDF.

labels.symptom: The roadmap overstates how close the app is to parity with the commercial original.
A command-line command fails or loses its result when writing diagnostics to stderr fails, and invalid page arguments are accepted.
labels.root_cause: Stderr diagnostic write errors were treated as fatal, and page arguments were not validated before file access.

labels.symptom: There is no keyboard shortcut to jump to a page number.
Edited Japanese sans-serif text turns into regular Mincho instead of keeping Gothic and bold.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese fallback always chose the regular Mincho face.

labels.symptom: GPU UI tests crash with STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION on Windows ARM64 CI.
labels.root_cause: WARP's ARM64 shader JIT crashes when tests compile shaders on two wgpu devices in parallel.

labels.symptom: Importing form data from CSV drops a multiline value and every column after it.
labels.root_cause: The importer split the file into lines before it parsed quotes.

labels.symptom: Pages are rendered more than once, and one slow page can tie up several render workers.
labels.root_cause: Re-sent queues put back requests a worker had already taken, so other workers rendered them again.

labels.symptom: Saving small edits to a large document copies it twice and keeps extra memory in use while it stays open.
labels.root_cause: Incremental save preallocated original+4096 bytes, so Vec growth doubled capacity and copied the original again.

labels.symptom: Arabic typed into added text comes out as question marks.
labels.root_cause: Added text used standard-14 WinAnsi fonts with no Arabic shaping or bidi.

labels.symptom: Rendering pages briefly uses twice the memory needed for each raster, especially while zooming.
labels.root_cause: Rendered pixmap bytes were copied with to_vec instead of moved out.

labels.symptom: Opening a document with extreme dash patterns exhausts memory or hangs, crashing the app with all open documents.
labels.root_cause: Stroke expansion in the vendored renderer emitted unbounded dashes and looped forever on negative-sum dash arrays.

labels.symptom: Exporting some PDFs to Word, HTML or RTF produces an empty document with no text or images.
labels.root_cause: Export read only the page's own content streams and did not follow form XObjects drawn with Do.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed PDF with a JBIG2 image hangs forever.
labels.root_cause: JBIG2 symbol dictionary loops did not make progress past the end of the arithmetic-coded data.

labels.symptom: After an edit or undo on a heavy page, the page takes about twice as long to redraw.
labels.root_cause: Dropping a render pool did not cancel in-progress page renders, which kept running to completion.

labels.symptom: Opening certain malformed PDFs hangs the app.
labels.root_cause: Self-referencing stream lengths, nested inline-image look-ahead and Type 3 glyph fan-out caused exponential parsing.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted PDF with a small compressed stream makes the app use gigabytes of memory and crash, closing all open documents.
labels.root_cause: The vendored PDF parser decoded Flate, LZW and RunLength streams with no output size limit.

labels.symptom: Some files make rendering use gigabytes of memory or run for minutes.
labels.root_cause: Mesh shading sampling and triangulation had no limits.

labels.symptom: XFA form choice lists, signature, password, image and barcode fields show as blank or plain text fields.
Large pages look blurry while you pinch-zoom until the new tiles finish rendering.
labels.root_cause: Each zoom step threw away the previous tiles before their replacements were ready.

labels.symptom: With many documents open, tabs overflow off the window and can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: The document tab bar was not in a horizontal scroll area and did not reveal the selected tab.

labels.symptom: Redrawing an annotation or form field loses its rollover and pressed appearances and push-button captions.
labels.root_cause: Appearance regeneration replaced the appearance dictionaries and did not resolve indirect push-button values.

labels.symptom: Opening or saving very large documents uses many gigabytes of memory and can run out of memory.
labels.root_cause: Documents were inspected eagerly, and the scan, write and raster caches had no size limits.

labels.symptom: No FreeBSD release package is available.
There is no way to search bookmark titles in the Bookmarks panel.
labels.root_cause: The Bookmarks panel lacked a filter field.

labels.symptom: On Windows, Chinese UI text and Chinese file names show as square boxes.
labels.root_cause: The installed-font fallback only probed for an Arabic face and never loaded an installed Chinese font.

labels.symptom: Some documents render warped and shrunken, with large white margins.
labels.root_cause: High-precision float mantissas overflowed with wrapping u64 arithmetic in the number parser.

labels.symptom: Opening a PDF with certain JBIG2 images hangs for minutes.
labels.root_cause: The JBIG2 decoder had no limit on bitmap or symbol pixel counts.

labels.symptom: Scanned Chinese documents cannot be recognised or made searchable.
Quick drags on a resize handle are ignored; only slow press-hold-move drags work.
labels.root_cause: The drag_started event was checked only while the pointer was still over the handle, so fast drags that had already left it were dropped instead of resolving the target from press_origin.

labels.symptom: Hebrew file names and labels show as replacement boxes on macOS, and right-to-left interface text reads in the wrong order.
labels.root_cause: Only one installed fallback font was loaded (the first with Arabic), and labels were laid out left to right.

labels.symptom: Picking a tool makes the panel rows jump away from under the pointer.
labels.root_cause: A format section was inserted at the top of the tool panel.

labels.symptom: Closing an inactive document tab switches the selection to a different tab.
labels.root_cause: Tab-close logic picked a new active index without keeping the currently selected document.

labels.symptom: Agent instructions don't point to the shared test corpora.
Long file names and paths in the recent files list run over the row's details and past the edge of the row.
labels.root_cause: Row text was painted at full length without truncating it to the available width.

labels.symptom: Builds and tests are not checked on FreeBSD.
Grouped figures in PDFs cannot be selected, moved or deleted in edit mode.
The MCP automation interface lacks common command tools, session resources and a panic boundary.
Importing a .p12/.pfx digital ID exported from Windows fails with 'not a PKCS #12 file'.
labels.root_cause: The DER parser rejected BER indefinite lengths and constructed OCTET STRINGs used by Windows.

labels.symptom: Chinese text in documents that use non-embedded CID fonts draws no glyphs.
labels.root_cause: The fallback for non-embedded fonts had no Chinese face, so Adobe-GB1/CNS1 fonts rendered nothing.

labels.symptom: Toolbar buttons, tabs and tool rows give no hover or press feedback, so it is unclear what is clickable.
An open document does not update when its file changes on disk.
Opening a PDF with certain embedded Type 1 fonts hangs or crashes with a stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: read-fonts 0.39 had a recursive tokenizer look-ahead that overflowed the stack on long runs of numbers.

labels.symptom: Files that were open when the app last closed are not reopened at the next start.
labels.root_cause: There was no option to save and restore the last session's open documents.

labels.symptom: Lengths are always shown in inches, with no global setting for metric units.
labels.root_cause: Units are hard-wired to inches and there is no preference based on the system region.

labels.symptom: Fill & Sign marks can't be flattened into the page when saving.
The interface cannot be shown in Bulgarian.
labels.root_cause: No Bulgarian translation catalog existed.

labels.symptom: Measurement formats, geospatial tools and 3D measurement controls are limited.
Page thumbnails in the Organize grid can't be zoomed and are too small to read.
Opening a document with an unusual annotation date can crash or report that it has no pages.
labels.root_cause: Date formatting sliced through a UTF-8 character, and the panic unwound after the renderer pages had been swapped out.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be switched to Japanese.
Opening a malformed PDF with a crafted image predictor can crash or exhaust memory.
labels.root_cause: PNG/TIFF predictor decoding sized scratch buffers from declared width and /Colors rather than available samples, with unchecked row-size arithmetic.

labels.symptom: No German interface language is available.
Typing Cyrillic into serif text fails with an error that the fallback font has no glyph.
labels.root_cause: The Type 3 fallback used only the first Japanese face, which lacks Cyrillic.
bug_markers: Japanese fallback font has no glyph

labels.symptom: Image stamps placed on rotated pages appear rotated by 90 degrees.
labels.root_cause: Stamp placement ignored the page's inherited /Rotate.

labels.symptom: Unfiltered streams can exceed the decoded size limit.
labels.root_cause: The raw copy path skipped the output length check.

labels.symptom: Messages produced by lower layers (reports, dialogs, history) stay in English even when the interface is set to another language.
labels.root_cause: Sentences worded by engine and library crates bypass the UI translation tables.

labels.symptom: Importing an XFDF annotation with a non-ASCII colour value fails or crashes.
labels.root_cause: Slicing a string by byte length split a multi-byte UTF-8 character.

labels.symptom: Files with crafted page labels can use excessive memory or time.
labels.root_cause: Page-label tree traversal and numeral formatting had no limits.

labels.symptom: A new highlight shows up in the comments panel without opening a note field for typing.
labels.root_cause: The inline editor opened only after a double-click or the Edit menu, not when a highlight was created.

labels.symptom: The Print dialog gives no way to reach the printer driver's own settings, such as paper tray or stapling.
An exported Word document with a 64-column table will not open in Word.
labels.root_cause: The table column cap was 64, but Word opens at most 63 columns.

labels.symptom: Half-width katakana in a non-embedded Japanese serif font draw as unrelated Latin glyphs.
labels.root_cause: The substitute Mincho face (Shippori Mincho) has no half-width katakana glyphs.

labels.symptom: Portrait phone photos show up rotated 90 degrees after they are inserted.
labels.root_cause: The JPEG EXIF Orientation tag was ignored when images were embedded.

labels.symptom: Dialog text fields are cramped, and long names in rows draw past the dialog edge.
labels.root_cause: Dialog frames and text fields used tight default padding, and row labels were not truncated.

labels.symptom: On Windows machines with an Intel GPU, the app crashes on launch with an access violation before the window appears.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's default Windows backends include Vulkan, which loads every installed Vulkan driver, and Intel's igvk64.dll crashes.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Italian translation, and UI tests fail when the developer's system language is not English.
labels.root_cause: Integration tests read the real system locale because cfg!(test) does not apply to them.

labels.symptom: Some PDFs crash the app or show no editable text because their font character maps are malformed or written without spaces.
labels.root_cause: The CMap parser split streams on whitespace, sliced hex tokens as UTF-8 and did unchecked arithmetic.

labels.symptom: Choices in a multi-select list are lost when form data is exported and then imported again as XML, CSV or text.
labels.root_cause: Import treated the comma-joined export cell as one choice, and the list rejected it.

labels.symptom: The comments sidebar pops open again every time a comment tool is picked, even after the user closed it.
labels.root_cause: Comment tools opened the panel whenever no right panel was open, ignoring that the user had closed it.

labels.symptom: UI integration tests fail on machines whose system language is not English.
labels.root_cause: cfg!(test) is off in integration tests, so the UI uses the system language and lookups by English label fail.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+wheel zoom does not stay anchored to the pointer, and there is no middle-button or Space+drag panning.
The format and language of stamped dates can't be chosen.
Korean text in file tabs and side panels shows as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: No embedded font covers Hangul, and the installed fallback font, chosen by probing for Arabic, has no Hangul either.

labels.symptom: There is no way to read a document one two-page spread at a time.
The interface cannot be shown in Ukrainian.
The app binary is larger than needed because it embeds the same Japanese font twice.
labels.root_cause: The UI theme include_bytes!'d a font that the fonts crate already embeds.

labels.symptom: Adding page text, headers/footers or watermarks with non-Latin characters writes '?' in place of each character and still reports success.
labels.root_cause: Characters outside WinAnsiEncoding were silently replaced with '?' instead of being rejected.

labels.symptom: Release builds queue for a long time behind macOS PR CI jobs.
labels.root_cause: PR CI used up the organisation's shared macOS runners.

labels.symptom: Mouse wheel scrolling is very slow, moving only a short distance per notch.
labels.root_cause: egui's default line_scroll_speed of 40 pt per wheel line is too low for Windows/Linux wheel notches.

labels.symptom: Long translated labels overlap or push other UI elements such as search shortcuts and card actions out of view.
labels.root_cause: Layouts did not reserve space for or shorten long localized text.

labels.symptom: Text in rotated form fields is drawn upright after filling them.
labels.root_cause: Regenerated appearances ignored the /MK /R rotation entry.

labels.symptom: Line comments draw only some of the PDF line-ending styles.
Editing Hebrew text shows the letters reversed or as replacement boxes.
labels.root_cause: Glyphs were joined in visual order instead of logical order, and the fallback fonts have no Hebrew.

labels.symptom: Heavy pages keep the CPU busy after a render has timed out.
labels.root_cause: The watchdog abandoned stuck workers without stopping them, because the stop flag belonged to the whole pool.

labels.symptom: Memory use stays higher than needed after a document is fully saved or rewritten.
labels.root_cause: The full-save output buffer grew by doubling and kept its unused capacity.

labels.symptom: Replacing text in serif lines with Cyrillic or Greek letters fails with a missing-glyph error.
labels.root_cause: The serif fallback font had no Cyrillic or Greek glyphs.
bug_markers: Japanese fallback font has no glyph

labels.symptom: Pages, thumbnails and print preview look blurry and low-resolution compared with other viewers.
labels.root_cause: Pages were drawn as small bitmaps and stretched up instead of being drawn at the size they are shown.

labels.symptom: Drag-and-drop open and comment hover had no tests.
The app quits at startup with a device-lost error on some GPUs, such as Intel Macs.
labels.root_cause: Only the wgpu renderer was built, with no fallback when it can't get an adapter, device or surface.

labels.symptom: Radio buttons and check boxes reject their export values when filling forms.
labels.root_cause: /Opt export values weren't mapped to the widgets' on-state names.

labels.symptom: Typing Japanese into form fields that use CID fonts shows '?' for every character.
labels.root_cause: Form appearance generation accepted only simple fonts and fell back to Helvetica with WinAnsi encoding for Type0 fonts.

labels.symptom: Ticking a check box whose on-state name uses a legacy encoding makes the box disappear instead of showing a check mark.
labels.root_cause: PDF name bytes for check box states were decoded as UTF-8, which replaced them with U+FFFD.

labels.symptom: There is no toolbar tool for squiggly-underline comments.
Running the command-line tool with --help doesn't print usage and exits with an error.
labels.root_cause: The usage text existed only in a source comment and --help wasn't handled.

labels.symptom: Some German labels and notices appear half in English.
labels.root_cause: Labels passed to tl! through variables weren't found by the coverage test, so they were never translated.

labels.symptom: Redacting phone numbers leaves the international prefix such as +49 visible.
labels.root_cause: The phone pattern accepted only North American 10/11-digit numbers.

labels.symptom: On Windows, dragging the window to a monitor with a different scale leaves it wrongly sized and blurry.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 handles WM_DPICHANGED using the monitor the window is leaving, which causes a resize loop.

labels.symptom: The interface isn't available in Hungarian.
Characters like Š š Ž ž Œ œ Ÿ … are written as ? in generated PDFs or forced into a fallback font.
labels.root_cause: Hand-written WinAnsi encoders covered only part of the 0x80–0x9F range.

labels.symptom: Exporting to Word, HTML or RTF turns coloured text black.
labels.root_cause: The export Block and Cell types had no colour field, so the text colour was dropped.

labels.symptom: Edited text shows up as bullets when the file is opened in Acrobat.
labels.root_cause: Type 3 fallback glyphs had a d1 operator with seven operands instead of six.

labels.symptom: Each pen stroke is selected right away, showing a bounding box and an author popup that get in the way of the next stroke.
labels.root_cause: apply_edit selected every new annotation, including ink strokes made while the ink tool was active.

labels.symptom: The comment quick bar has no opacity control.
In single-page view the up and down arrow keys don't turn pages.
labels.root_cause: In single-page view the arrow keys only scrolled within the page and never moved to the next or previous page.

labels.symptom: Memory use doubles after saving a large document and stays high until the document is closed.
labels.root_cause: Stream data was copied out of the file buffer into the object cache instead of pointing into the shared buffer.

labels.symptom: After a restart, a newly opened document starts part-way down instead of at the top.
labels.root_cause: egui saves scroll offsets keyed by per-launch document IDs, and those IDs restart at 1 each launch, so new documents pick up old offsets.

labels.symptom: Large page rasters cost UI-thread time and frame drops while they are copied into egui images.
labels.root_cause: ColorImage::from_rgba_premultiplied copied each pixel because Vec<u8> isn't aligned for Color32.

labels.symptom: Bookmarks and links only jump to the top of the target page, ignoring position and zoom.
labels.root_cause: Destinations were reduced to a page index only.

labels.symptom: There is no way to clear the recent-files list or remove one file from it.
On Linux desktops with a monitor on each of two GPUs, the app crashes at startup with a surface-lost error.
labels.root_cause: Adapter selection preferred the integrated GPU whenever it drove a display, and that adapter could not configure the surface.

labels.symptom: On Windows, debug test builds use tens of gigabytes because each test binary gets a huge PDB.
labels.root_cause: Dependencies were built with full debug info in the dev profile.

labels.symptom: The author name on new comments can't be changed.
Shift+click clears the text selection instead of extending it.
labels.root_cause: The click handler cleared the selection no matter which modifiers were held.

labels.symptom: Typed or drawn signatures come out sideways or upside down on rotated pages.
labels.root_cause: Signature geometry was laid out in user-space axes and ignored the page /Rotate.

labels.symptom: Dragging with the middle mouse button draws or edits with the current tool instead of panning the view.
labels.root_cause: egui drag responses accept every pointer button, so middle-button drags reach the active tool.

labels.symptom: On Windows the interface comes up in English instead of the user's display language when launched with a neutral C locale.
labels.root_cause: Automatic language selection treated LANG=C.UTF-8 as English before checking the Windows display languages.

labels.symptom: After you click the thumbnail of a short page, the current page jumps to the taller page below it.
labels.root_cause: The current page was whichever page showed the most of itself on screen.

labels.symptom: In builds without MCP, the command-line help still lists the mcp command, and running it reports an unknown command.
labels.root_cause: The usage text was static and ignored the mcp feature flag.

labels.symptom: A page containing a 32-bit JPEG2000 image fails to render entirely.
labels.root_cause: The JPEG2000 sample normalizer computed 1<<32, overflowing and panicking.

labels.symptom: Some labels appear in English in the French interface.
labels.root_cause: The French catalog was incomplete.

labels.symptom: On Windows, launching the app opens a console window, and the Start Menu shortcut has no icon.
labels.root_cause: The release binary used the console subsystem, and the MSI Icon Id had no .ico extension.

labels.symptom: A test sometimes fails when two saves fall on either side of a second boundary.
labels.root_cause: The test compares saves that stamp the current time without pinning the clock.

labels.symptom: A malformed PDF shading function makes the whole page fail to render.
labels.root_cause: Calculator functions panicked on division by zero, overflow and bad shifts, and function nesting had no limits.

labels.symptom: The line ending menu in comment properties shows raw PDF tokens instead of readable, translated names.
In the browser version, a slow startup URL document takes over the active tab, so the next Save goes to the wrong document.
labels.root_cause: Startup downloads went through the same foreground inbox as a deliberate Open.

labels.symptom: Ukrainian labels are ambiguous, and CI fails because of duplicate tests.
Parts of the Japanese interface fall back to English.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese catalog was missing strings.

labels.symptom: Existing text boxes can't be moved or resized while editing.
On Windows the MSI installer needs administrator rights and can't install for the current user only.
labels.root_cause: The MSI is per-machine only, with HKLM registry keys and a launch condition requiring ALLUSERS=1.

labels.symptom: CI on main fails the crate layering check.
labels.root_cause: A dev-dependency between two crates in the same layer broke the layering rules.

labels.symptom: Some PDF images with extreme dimensions can trigger huge memory allocations while rendering.
labels.root_cause: Image resampling buffers were not bounded before they were allocated.

labels.symptom: UI tests fail on machines whose display language is not English.
labels.root_cause: Test harnesses did not pin the interface language.

labels.symptom: Some Hungarian labels are worded incorrectly.
The same document cannot be opened in a second window.
Another local user can plant the automation control file and capture the commands and token the CLI sends.
labels.root_cause: The CLI never checked who owned the control file, and the app only logged a failed control-file write.

labels.symptom: The Windows command-line executable shows no version or publisher in Explorer or inventory tools.
labels.root_cause: The CLI binary had no build.rs embedding a Windows version resource.

labels.symptom: Changing one paragraph's text colour also recolours all the text after it.
labels.root_cause: The rewritten paragraph was not wrapped in q/Q, so its fill colour leaked into the text after it.

labels.symptom: Saving a file opened from an Outlook attachment fails or writes to a temporary copy that is later deleted.
labels.root_cause: Save wrote back to Outlook's cache copy instead of treating it like an untitled document.

labels.symptom: Most of the interface is untranslated in Brazilian Portuguese.
CI fails to compile because tests are defined more than once.
labels.root_cause: Squash merges added duplicate copies of the same test block.

labels.symptom: Pages cannot be deleted directly from the page thumbnails panel.
The parity check fails because it cites a test name that no longer exists.
labels.root_cause: The parity evidence cited a renamed test.

labels.symptom: The app crashes at launch when a restored window is larger than the GPU's maximum texture size, for example a large HiDPI window.
labels.root_cause: The surface was configured at the full window size without clamping it to max_texture_dimension_2d, so wgpu's Surface::configure panicked.
bug_markers: Surface width and height must be within the maximum supported texture size

labels.symptom: Text in Symbol and ZapfDingbats fonts is read as Latin letters, so search and redaction miss or misidentify it.
labels.root_cause: Simple fonts with no ToUnicode map fell back to StandardEncoding, and glyph names were not decoded with the naming algorithm.

labels.symptom: With many documents open, tabs scroll at full width and the Open button scrolls out of sight.
labels.root_cause: Tabs kept their full width and the Open button sat inside the scrolling area.

labels.symptom: On Linux the command-line tool is only available inside the large desktop packages.
labels.root_cause: The Linux packaging script had no CLI-only archive format.

labels.symptom: Bookmark titles show garbled characters, a stray invisible mark or nothing at all.
labels.root_cause: lopdf's decoder mishandled UTF-8 byte-order marks and raw UTF-8 text.

labels.symptom: Documents with only push buttons show a form-fields bar, and Screen annotations appear as comments.
labels.root_cause: The form notice fired on any field, and the comment filter excluded only Link, Widget and Popup annotations.

labels.symptom: On Windows with an old GPU the app aborts at launch before any window appears.
labels.root_cause: egui-wgpu let surface configuration errors reach wgpu's uncaptured-error handler, which panics, so the OpenGL fallback never ran.

labels.symptom: Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Tables come out as loose paragraphs when exporting to Word, HTML or RTF.
A signature chained through a non-CA certificate can be shown as trusted.
labels.root_cause: Chain building did not check basicConstraints, key usage, path length or validity.

labels.symptom: An unmodified document with a timestamp field is reported as altered.
labels.root_cause: Timestamp field values were validated as CMS signatures.

labels.symptom: Signatures from qualified EU or commercial CAs show as Unknown instead of Valid.
labels.root_cause: There was no built-in root store and no way to load trust lists.

labels.symptom: The app runs slowly with a software renderer and gives no visible explanation.
labels.root_cause: Software rasterizer detection was only written to the log.

labels.symptom: Text lines whose operator is split across content stream pieces cannot be selected or edited.
labels.root_cause: Each piece of the page's /Contents array was parsed on its own, so operands at the end of one piece were lost.

labels.symptom: Adds signature timestamps, long-term validation data and revocation checks to digital signatures.
Installed releases say that model-based features are not installed because their models are missing.
labels.root_cause: Packaging scripts never bundled the model files that were fetched only into the source tree.

labels.symptom: On Windows desktops with two GPUs the window stays black or the display driver resets.
labels.root_cause: The low-power adapter preference picked the integrated GPU, which doesn't drive the monitors, and presenting across GPUs crashed the driver.

labels.symptom: Images in documents look blurry when zoomed out.
labels.root_cause: Non-interpolated images were minified with a smoothing filter instead of nearest-neighbour sampling.

labels.symptom: Text in an edited form field disappears for a few seconds after focus leaves the field.
labels.root_cause: Page tiles were purged on page change, so non-focused fields stayed blank until the slow re-render finished.

labels.symptom: Imported signature images keep their white paper background.
A UI test fails intermittently on slow machines.
labels.root_cause: The test selected text before the page had finished loading.

labels.symptom: CI workflows show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: The workflows pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: The docs don't explain how to register the MCP server from an installed release, because the CLI isn't on PATH.
labels.root_cause: The docs only covered registering the CLI from a source build.

labels.symptom: Windows builds fail to compile.
labels.root_cause: New PublicKey enum variants were not handled in the Windows signing match statements.

labels.symptom: Forms whose fields exist only as page widgets show nothing fillable.
labels.root_cause: Field enumeration walked only the AcroForm /Fields array, ignoring unlisted page widget annotations.

labels.symptom: Opening an XFA form shows only a placeholder or regular fields, with no explanation.
labels.root_cause: XFA data wasn't detected.

labels.symptom: Form field properties can only be edited one field at a time.
There is no repeatable way to check how the app is registered with Finder, Quick Look and Spotlight on macOS.
On Linux the Print dialog lists only Save as PDF and none of the network driverless printers.
labels.root_cause: The printer list used lpstat -p -d, which lists only permanent CUPS queues, not driverless destinations from lpstat -e.

labels.symptom: No native Windows ARM64 installer is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline built only x64 and x86 Windows binaries.

labels.symptom: Search, copy and selection read ligatures in rotated, vertical or Arabic text in the wrong order.
labels.root_cause: The text layer split multi-character glyphs into equal parts along view x regardless of writing direction.

labels.symptom: Characters missing from a substitute font draw as unrelated glyphs instead of a blank box.
labels.root_cause: map_code fell back to using the CID as a glyph index of the substitute font.

labels.symptom: Many common kanji in non-embedded Japanese fonts draw as wrong glyphs or not at all.
labels.root_cause: map_via_unicode accepted only single characters, not ideographic variation sequences from Adobe-Japan1-UCS2.

labels.symptom: The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There is no omastore.toml manifest.

labels.symptom: Truncated page renders look clean, misspelled CLI options are ignored, and a failed render blocks other scales from recovering.
labels.root_cause: Render results carried no truncation warnings, the watchdog key lacked full request identity, and CLI parsing was permissive.

labels.symptom: The Windows Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs icon are blank.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension.

labels.symptom: Large pages render slowly because each tile draws every path on the page.
labels.root_cause: The renderer set up and stroked every path before discarding what falls outside the tile.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, IME input stops working after a touch screen, tablet or remote session is disconnected, until restart.
labels.root_cause: winit's remove_capability destroys the seat's text input whichever capability is removed.

labels.symptom: On Windows, no caret is shown while composing Korean text in text fields.
labels.root_cause: winit reads GCS_CURSORPOS without checking the lParam flag, so the Microsoft Korean IME reports cursor 0.

labels.symptom: On Windows, a window closed while maximized reopens with a white unpainted flash before the first frame.
labels.root_cause: winit applies maximized with ShowWindow(SW_MAXIMIZE), which shows a window that eframe created hidden.

labels.symptom: On X11 the input method (IBus, fcitx5) stops working when focus moves between text fields until the window loses and regains focus.
labels.root_cause: winit recreates the X input context on each IME allow change but only focuses it on FocusIn.

labels.symptom: On macOS, text committed through an input method (e.g. Korean syllable-ending keys, mouse-picked candidates) is lost or the next key is swallowed.
labels.root_cause: winit's insertText: drops committed text when the input method clears marked text before inserting.

labels.symptom: On macOS an unfinished IME composition reappears and is committed again after focus leaves a text field and comes back.
labels.root_cause: winit's set_ime_allowed(false) clears its own marked text but never tells NSTextInputContext to discard the composition.

labels.symptom: On macOS, emoji chosen from the emoji picker never appear in text fields.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 only reports insertText during a key press or composition, and the picker inserts outside both.

labels.symptom: On macOS with Apple Korean input, Space types two spaces when no syllable is in progress.
labels.root_cause: winit sends the IME-committed text and also a KeyboardInput event for the same key.

labels.symptom: Czech isn't available as an interface language.
