On macOS, the first Korean word typed after launch comes out as separate jamo instead of a composed syllable.
labels.root_cause: On the first key, Apple Korean IME sends insertText with raw jamo, and winit forwards it as an ordinary key.

labels.symptom: Importing a large TIFF image fails with 'decoder limits exceeded', while PNGs of the same size work.
labels.root_cause: The tiff crate's default decoder limits cap the decoded buffer at 256 MiB.

labels.symptom: Chinese text shows as tofu boxes in the interface and file names, or Han characters render in Japanese shapes and sit off the Latin baseline.
labels.root_cause: No installed Chinese system font was located and registered for both zh-hans and zh-hant ahead of Japanese faces, and fallback glyph baselines were not aligned.

labels.symptom: Signatures can't carry trusted timestamps or long-term validation data, and revocation isn't checked.
Adding a new signing key type could break the Windows build or silently skip certificate store signing.
labels.root_cause: Key-type matches lived in a Windows-only module with wildcard arms.

labels.symptom: Arabic interface text shows words in left-to-right order.
labels.root_cause: egui joins Arabic letters but lays out words left to right, so RTL strings need reordering into display order.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, menus and tooltips show macOS ⌘ shortcuts instead of Ctrl.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut labels were hard-coded with ⌘ strings, and the macOS check was done at compile time instead of from the runtime OS.

labels.symptom: Clicking outside the command palette does not close it.
labels.root_cause: The palette only closed on Escape or command selection, not on a click outside it.

labels.symptom: No test checked that a page rendered in tiles matches the page rendered whole.
An annotation with a fractional flags value shows as unlocked but edits are rejected as locked.
labels.root_cause: Different code paths read the annotation /F flag as float or integer inconsistently.

labels.symptom: Render watchdog tests are slow and sometimes fail at random.
labels.root_cause: The tests used sleeps and wall-clock timing to arrange worker interleavings.

labels.symptom: After a paragraph is edited, it moves ahead of earlier text in reading order, and later edits change the wrong paragraph.
labels.root_cause: The rewritten paragraph was put back before the BT of a text object it shared with other paragraphs, instead of the text object being split.

labels.symptom: Embedded PDF fonts with out-of-range descriptor flags can be wrongly treated as bold and italic.
labels.root_cause: The metrics path saturated out-of-range font descriptor flags to u32::MAX, while the renderer rejected them.

labels.symptom: Form checkboxes with invalid field flag values are reported as read-only pushbuttons.
labels.root_cause: Signed field flag integers were cast with `as u32`, wrapping negative and oversized values.

labels.symptom: The visible page takes a long time to render because the worker is still busy with a page that is no longer needed.
labels.root_cause: Requests already in progress were not cancelled when the render queue was replaced, and a request removed during publication slipped past the check.

labels.symptom: The About dialog Contributors test fails intermittently because the Table toggle is clicked while the dialog is still moving.
labels.root_cause: The test waited a fixed number of frames while the auto-centred modal was still resizing and recentring.

labels.symptom: A side panel slowly grows wider again after you resize it narrower.
labels.root_cause: Rows wider than the panel made egui store a larger panel width on every repaint.

labels.symptom: No user-visible change; adds a test that page pixels are the same whatever the render worker count.
The content-stream parser is tied to slice-based input, which blocks a future streaming tokenizer.
No user-visible change; adds a test that a shared form object picks up each page's own color space.
Shape annotations with a malformed interior colour are not drawn at all, so their border disappears.
labels.root_cause: Appearance building passed the /IC parse failure upward with ? instead of falling back to the no-colour case.

labels.symptom: No tests covered indirect form recursion cycles.
UI tests that render pixels crash now and then with an access violation on Windows ARM64 CI runners that have no GPU.
labels.root_cause: The WARP software renderer crashes when two wgpu devices compile shaders at the same time in parallel tests.

labels.symptom: No tests covered recursion cycles between tiling patterns and forms.
No user-visible change; adds a test that undo and redo never re-run form field scripts.
There are no deterministic tests checking that measurement snapping stays bounded on mutated geometry.
On Windows, opening several files at once from Explorer opens several windows instead of one.
labels.root_cause: Launches started at the same moment race on the single-instance socket; a launch can't clear a socket that another launch has bound but isn't listening on yet.

labels.symptom: A soft mask shared by two forms renders wrongly the second time it is used.
labels.root_cause: The soft-mask cache key did not include the inherited resource context.

labels.symptom: Large-format pages that set a user unit are shown, printed and edited at the wrong size.
labels.root_cause: /UserUnit was ignored everywhere except the measuring tools.

labels.symptom: A thumbnail memory test fails intermittently.
labels.root_cause: The test hard-coded an outdated thumbnail size and raced a real background render.

labels.symptom: Windows CI builds pass even when the executable's resources fail to compile.
labels.root_cause: Windows CI did not set the flag that makes resource compilation failures fatal.

labels.symptom: On Windows, text and the user interface may look blurry or fuzzy on high-DPI displays.
labels.root_cause: The executable manifest declared no Per-Monitor V2 DPI awareness, so Windows could apply DPI virtualization and bitmap scaling.

labels.symptom: Logs from a successful launch don't always say which GPU adapter, backend or texture limit was used.
labels.root_cause: Renderer details were logged only inside the custom adapter-selection callback, which doesn't run on every launch.

labels.symptom: Images turned into a PDF lose their embedded ICC colour profile, so CMYK images become untagged device colour.
labels.root_cause: Image embedding ignored JPEG APP2 ICC_PROFILE and PNG iCCP chunks and always wrote a device colour space.

labels.symptom: Checking for updates shows a bare 'http status: 403' error when GitHub rate-limits the request.
labels.root_cause: The update check let ureq turn the 403 rate-limit response into an opaque error instead of reading the status and the rate-limit headers.

labels.symptom: Converting a CMYK-only document to PDF/A adds an sRGB output intent, and the check still calls the file compliant.
labels.root_cause: Convert always added an sRGB intent, and verify only checked that some output intent existed.

labels.symptom: No user-visible change; adds a test that inactive document views release their cached textures.
In the dark theme the text caret is white and cannot be seen in text boxes with light backgrounds.
labels.root_cause: The caret takes its colour from the dark theme's visuals instead of contrasting with the box's fixed light fill.

labels.symptom: Text extracted from rotated or diagonal text comes out garbled, with missing spaces or lines in the wrong order.
labels.root_cause: Glyphs were snapped to four writing directions and laid out by axis-aligned boxes that overlap when the text is turned.

labels.symptom: At the same fixed zoom percentage, pages show at a different size than in the reference app.
labels.root_cause: 100% zoom always uses a 96-ppi basis, with no setting for page display resolution.

labels.symptom: Redaction marks can't use standard redaction code sets as overlay text.
Signing with a smart card or USB token on Windows fails with error 80090022 and no PIN prompt appears.
labels.root_cause: The key handle acquired silently for listing was reused for signing, so the provider could not show its PIN dialog.

labels.symptom: Long digital ID names run past the right edge of the signing dialog.
labels.root_cause: Rows painted their name and issuer text without clipping.

labels.symptom: Text from overlapping runs comes out with its letters jumbled together when extracted.
labels.root_cause: Overprinting runs on one baseline were merged into one segment and their glyphs sorted by x.

labels.symptom: Documents signed with certificates not meant for document signing are reported as valid.
labels.root_cause: Validation didn't check key usage, extended key usage or unknown critical extensions.

labels.symptom: The repo ships a large bundled Japanese font instead of taking Japanese fonts from the shared font set.
labels.root_cause: Japanese fonts were committed into the repo instead of being an optional craft-fonts build input.

labels.symptom: Editing document metadata needlessly rebuilds the page renderer.
labels.root_cause: refresh_scoped replaced the render pool for metadata edits.

labels.symptom: Extracting pages gives no way to choose the output file name.
labels.root_cause: The extract dialog had no file name field and used fixed name patterns.

labels.symptom: Signing a password-protected PDF fails with an error that encrypted documents aren't supported.
labels.root_cause: The writer encrypted the signature's /Contents placeholder, so it couldn't be patched in place after hashing.

labels.symptom: Bookmarks can't be created from a tagged document's headings.
Find-and-redact can't redact a list of several words or phrases in one go.
e-Aadhaar PDF signatures cannot be verified.
Windows certificate store identities that can't sign are silently missing from the Sign dialog with no explanation.
labels.root_cause: Certificate listing dropped unusable certificates (no private key, unsupported curve, key needing UI prompt) instead of reporting them.

labels.symptom: Exported cut-out images lose their transparency and get a solid white or black background.
labels.root_cause: Image extraction ignored soft masks, stencil masks and color-key masks, and wrote JPEGs byte for byte without their alpha.

labels.symptom: JPEG colour profiles or density stored after the frame header are ignored when creating documents from images.
labels.root_cause: The metadata scanner stopped at SOF and mishandled marker fill bytes.

labels.symptom: There is no way to Alt-drag to select only the text inside a rectangle, such as a single column.
Thai text cannot be entered or drawn because Thai characters are rejected or have no font.
labels.root_cause: No Thai font face or Thai shaping support is included.

labels.symptom: Antivirus scanners flag the Windows installer or executable as malware.
labels.root_cause: A generic repeated-byte YARA match in the executable.

labels.symptom: In two-page view, Next page does nothing because it targets the page already on screen.
labels.root_cause: Page navigation stepped one page instead of a whole spread in two-page layout.

labels.symptom: A malicious document script can crash the app by making it allocate huge amounts of memory.
labels.root_cause: util.printf widths and sparse array lengths were not limited before native allocation.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted PDF crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Compressed-object lookups in vendored lopdf recursed without cycle tracking, which caused a stack overflow.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted PDF with deeply nested arrays or dictionaries crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: The PDF parser recursed once per nesting level with no depth limit and overflowed the stack.

labels.symptom: Combine files offers only a table and no thumbnail grid view.
The viewer find test fails intermittently on a loaded machine.
labels.root_cause: The test waited a fixed number of frames instead of polling up to a deadline.

labels.symptom: Exported Word documents fail to open in Microsoft Word with an error.
labels.root_cause: Extracted text contained XML-forbidden control characters, and page heights exceeded Word's 22-inch maximum.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Polish.
On Linux Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a prohibited cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not implement drag-and-drop on Wayland, so the app has to run through XWayland.

labels.symptom: Files in the combine-files grid cannot be expanded into separate page cards.
Single pages cannot be moved or removed before combining files.
Thai file names show as replacement boxes in tabs, the window title and the recent files list.
labels.root_cause: The installed fallback font was probed only for Arabic, so a face with no Thai glyphs, such as Segoe UI, was chosen.

labels.symptom: Rectangle, oval and polygon comments can only have a border color, not a fill color.
An automation tool given file paths outside the allowed root returns success with per-file errors instead of refusing the call.
labels.root_cause: The batch tool checked paths one at a time during processing instead of resolving all of them against the root before starting.

labels.symptom: OCR reads the euro sign as the letter E.
labels.root_cause: The ocrs default alphabet has E where the model was trained with €.

labels.symptom: Very large page content streams are cut off or use too much memory.
labels.root_cause: Each page's decoded content stream was materialised whole, up to a 256 MiB cap.

labels.symptom: On macOS, opening a file from Finder, Open With or the Dock shows an error saying the app cannot open files of that format.
labels.root_cause: winit does not handle the open-documents Apple event and Info.plist did not declare the document type.

labels.symptom: A placed signature can't be moved or resized while a Fill & Sign tool is active.
labels.root_cause: Page input for Fill tools always went to placement and never to the select/move logic.

labels.symptom: On macOS, the app in the DMG fails codesign --verify --strict because of Finder info detritus.
labels.root_cause: hdiutil makehybrid writes com.apple.FinderInfo on every file in the image.

labels.symptom: Arabic text is reversed, shown with the wrong glyphs or as tofu when added or edited.
labels.root_cause: Arabic shaping and bidi layout are missing for installed and document fonts.

labels.symptom: On Intel Iris Xe laptops, letters in menus and text boxes sometimes render broken and overlapping until the app restarts.
labels.root_cause: The DirectX 12 wgpu backend uploads the re-sent font atlas texture wrongly; OpenGL is not affected.

labels.symptom: Roadmap session log update.
Text containing certain Unicode characters such as İ makes URL detection crash with an out-of-range slice panic.
labels.root_cause: Offsets found in a lowercased copy were used to slice the original text, though lowercasing can change length.

labels.symptom: Phrase search misses words in the document that are separated by more than one space.
labels.root_cause: Whitespace was collapsed in the query but not in the extracted page text.

labels.symptom: A notice bar's message runs under its buttons and into the side panel when space is narrow or the translation is long.
labels.root_cause: The message was laid out before the buttons, so it had no width limit.

labels.symptom: Rotating pages by an angle that is not a multiple of 90 silently saves a different rotation and reports success.
labels.root_cause: The degrees value was integer-divided by 90 without checking it.

labels.symptom: A very large header start number wraps the next page number to zero.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked u32 addition overflowed.

labels.symptom: Shift-Command-G goes to the next match instead of the previous one.
labels.root_cause: egui shortcut matching for Command-G also matches with Shift held, and it was checked first.

labels.symptom: Password-protected PDFs saved by the app are reported as damaged by Adobe Acrobat.
labels.root_cause: The catalog was written inside an object stream in encrypted files, which Acrobat rejects.

labels.symptom: Text in PDFs whose fonts have large ToUnicode maps loses its later character mappings when copied or extracted.
labels.root_cause: The CMap parser expanded each range into one entry per code and stopped at a 2^20 cap, throwing away valid mappings.

labels.symptom: Flattening comments erases a visible note that has no stored appearance and saves a blank page.
labels.root_cause: Flatten only drew annotations with an /AP /N stream but removed every selected annotation anyway.

labels.symptom: Comment listings leave out replies to other replies.
labels.root_cause: The listing collected only replies whose /IRT pointed at the root comment.

labels.symptom: Interface text looks blurry and low-contrast, most visibly on Windows at 100–150% scaling.
labels.root_cause: egui sub-pixel glyph binning blurs text, linear edge blending thins dark text, and faint text colours fell below WCAG AA contrast.

labels.symptom: Generated comment summaries leave out replies to replies.
labels.root_cause: Only direct replies matching /IRT were collected.

labels.symptom: A page that embeds the web build in an iframe cannot hand it a file or get the saved bytes back; saving always downloads the file.
Save and Close ignore text being typed in an open in-place editor, losing the edit without a prompt.
labels.root_cause: The open paragraph draft was not counted as unsaved work.

labels.symptom: Documents with very long page labels cannot be read or edited.
labels.root_cause: Page labels were expanded eagerly and the whole set was refused above a 4 MiB total.
bug_markers: custom labels exceed 4 MiB in total

labels.symptom: On Windows the Print dialog lists no printers and only offers Save as PDF.
labels.root_cause: The Windows printer list returned empty and job submission was unimplemented.

labels.symptom: Polygon and polyline comments lose their shape after an XFDF export and import.
labels.root_cause: The XFDF export and import did not write or read the vertices.

labels.symptom: Reduce file size leaves office scans the same size or saves a bigger copy.
labels.root_cause: Images with a default decode array were skipped, and non-smaller results were saved anyway.

labels.symptom: A newly created, unsaved document gets no autosave recovery snapshot until it is edited.
labels.root_cause: Opening a new document marked it dirty but did not bump its generation past the snapshot generation, so autosave skipped it.

labels.symptom: After pages are deleted, named destinations and links still point to null pages.
labels.root_cause: delete_pages ignored the named destination stores.

labels.symptom: Extracting the same page twice makes both copies share annotations, so editing one edits the other.
labels.root_cause: The copier reused its cached annotation copies for the repeated page.

labels.symptom: Repeating table rows in XFA forms show only one row, and totals over the rows stay empty.
labels.root_cause: Repeating subforms in positioned areas were not expanded into instances, and areas were wrongly treated as data scopes.

labels.symptom: Callout comments lose their leader and arrowhead after an XFDF export and import.
labels.root_cause: The XFDF export and import skipped the /CL, /RD, /IT and /LE keys.

labels.symptom: Deleting the page a PDF opens to saves a null opening destination.
labels.root_cause: Page deletion cleaned bookmarks and links but not the catalog /OpenAction.

labels.symptom: In the browser, reloading or closing the tab silently discards unsaved edits without a warning.
labels.root_cause: eframe on the web never raises a viewport close request, so the unsaved-changes prompt never runs.

labels.symptom: After cancelling the password prompt for a recovered document, the next unlocked document saves over the other document's original file.
labels.root_cause: The recovery metadata stayed in an app-level pending field after cancel and was consumed by the next unlocked document.

labels.symptom: Fit to width in single-page view shows narrower pages too small.
labels.root_cause: Fit width zoom used the widest page in the document instead of the shown page.

labels.symptom: Clicking elsewhere while typing in a new text box discards the typed text.
labels.root_cause: A click with press and release in the same frame opened a new box before the editor finished the old one on focus loss.

labels.symptom: Re-importing comments leaves stale popup annotations that pile up in the file.
labels.root_cause: Replacing a note by /NM did not remove its Popup annotation.

labels.symptom: Printing with comments shows a scaled annotation appearance larger than its rectangle.
labels.root_cause: The appearance /Matrix was applied twice, once in the placement and again by the form's Do.

labels.symptom: Measurement snapping ignores the closing edge of a filled shape that has no explicit close.
labels.root_cause: Only the s, b and b* operators added the implicit closing edge as a snap target.

labels.symptom: Splitting a document at bookmarks with repeated titles leaves fewer output files than reported, because later parts overwrite earlier ones.
labels.root_cause: Output file names were taken from the bookmark titles without deduplication, and the comparison ignored case-insensitive file systems.

labels.symptom: Touchpad scrolling lags slightly behind the finger instead of following it 1:1.
labels.root_cause: egui eases precise wheel deltas because Windows touchpads send no TouchPhase::Start, so the no-smoothing path is never taken.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
In documents with very many bookmarks, the later bookmarks are missing from the list and can't be edited.
labels.root_cause: Outline traversal stopped at a fixed 100,000-item cap and dropped deep levels without saying so.

labels.symptom: Batch processing files with the same name from different folders silently overwrites earlier results.
labels.root_cause: Output filenames were derived from the input basename and written with a replacing atomic writer.

labels.symptom: Chinese interface text shows as empty boxes instead of characters.
labels.root_cause: Embedded UI fonts lack Simplified Chinese glyphs and system font fallback lists only Western fonts, probed with an Arabic character.

labels.symptom: Roadmap session log update.
On Linux, windows show two title bars: the system one and the app's own.
labels.root_cause: The window manager decorations stay on even though the app draws its own title bar.

labels.symptom: On Linux, the 'use system setting' theme does not follow the desktop's dark or light mode.
labels.root_cause: winit reports no system theme on Linux, so the System preference had nothing to resolve against.

labels.symptom: Combining files keeps every copy of identical images, making the output file huge.
labels.root_cause: Dedupe compared indirect references to colour spaces by reference, not by value.

labels.symptom: Shortcut key names stay in English (for example Ctrl instead of Strg) when the interface is in another language.
labels.root_cause: The code that formats shortcuts for display skipped localization, and the toolbar, menus, palette and help each formatted them differently.

labels.symptom: Batch processing files with the same name from different folders silently overwrites earlier results.
labels.root_cause: Output filenames were derived from the input basename without checking for collisions.

labels.symptom: On Windows, the app's document files show the app icon in Explorer instead of a document icon.
labels.root_cause: The installer registered no separate document icon resource.

labels.symptom: In the Windows portable package, every opened file starts a new window instead of a tab in the running instance.
labels.root_cause: Single-instance handoff was turned off whenever portable mode was active.

labels.symptom: Case-insensitive search doesn't find Turkish words containing dotted or dotless i in a different case.
labels.root_cause: Case folding uses str::to_lowercase, which maps İ to two characters and leaves ı distinct from I.

labels.symptom: Reducing or optimizing a PDF keeps the data of deleted images, so the file stays large.
labels.root_cause: The optimizer kept XObjects listed in page resources even when nothing drew them.

labels.symptom: Continuous scrolling is a separate page display option instead of a checkbox that works with single-page or two-page view.
labels.root_cause: The page layout enum mixed the base layout and the scrolling mode into one single-choice setting.

labels.symptom: Keyboard shortcuts such as Close or Undo act on the document behind an open dialog.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut handler did not check whether a modal dialog was open.

labels.symptom: License files and brand terms don't follow the shared licensing standard.
Redact-by-pattern misses dates with non-English month names.
labels.root_cause: The month list was English only, and locale-free lowercasing broke Turkish I/İ/ı matching.

labels.symptom: Redact-by-pattern misses internationalized email addresses.
labels.root_cause: The email pattern accepted only ASCII letters and digits.

labels.symptom: The interface opens too large or too small, can't be resized, and ignores the desktop's text scaling setting.
labels.root_cause: There was no interface-scale setting, and GNOME's text-scaling-factor was never read.

labels.symptom: Text files saved as UTF-16 or in a Windows code page import as garbled characters.
labels.root_cause: Text files were decoded with String::from_utf8_lossy, ignoring byte order marks and legacy encodings.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app's menus are not in the system menu bar at the top of the screen.
Encrypted PDFs whose password has non-ASCII characters won't open even with the correct password.
labels.root_cause: Passwords were encoded as Latin-1 or UTF-8 instead of PDFDocEncoding for security handler revisions 2–4.

labels.symptom: Several objects on a page cannot be selected and moved together.
On Linux Wayland sessions, dragging a file onto the window does nothing.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30's Wayland backend does not implement file drag and drop, and pointer position during drag was only implemented on macOS.

labels.symptom: Printing a document with mixed portrait and landscape pages on Windows is refused.
labels.root_cause: A single PrintTicket per job allowed only one sheet orientation.
bug_markers: requires one sheet size and orientation per job

labels.symptom: Text can be copied out of a protected PDF whose permissions forbid copying.
labels.root_cause: The copy-permission bit was read but never enforced on copy, snapshot or export.

labels.symptom: A signature over a form field can't be dragged with the Select tool.
labels.root_cause: The form-field input took the press before the comment drag could start.

labels.symptom: Typed text disappears when clicking away from a text box, and the box doesn't grow while typing.
labels.root_cause: Input handling replaced the box before it could commit, and a TextEdit inside an egui Area is clamped to the previous frame's width.

labels.symptom: There is no SDK or REST service for processing documents from code.
Opening certain damaged files crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Cross-reference object-number ranges were not validated, so they could overflow or wrap.

labels.symptom: Drawn signatures and ink drawings can't be resized.
labels.root_cause: Resizing was refused for ink annotations.

labels.symptom: White or pale text disappears while being edited inline because the edit box is always white.
labels.root_cause: The inline text editor box was always filled white regardless of the text colour.

labels.symptom: In a Chinese interface many characters show as missing-glyph boxes or in a Japanese font.
labels.root_cause: Release builds bundle no Simplified Chinese font, and the system font fallback only looked for an Arabic-capable face.

labels.symptom: Accessibility checks skip structure elements in very large documents.
labels.root_cause: The structure tree was copied into memory with a 2,000,000-element cap.

labels.symptom: Middle-click autoscroll behaves differently per platform; a short middle press does nothing on Windows and macOS.
labels.root_cause: Autoscroll used a drag-pan path on non-Linux platforms instead of latched autoscroll.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Cmd+W does nothing when no document is open instead of closing the window.
labels.root_cause: Cmd+W always goes to the close-document command, which is disabled when no document is open.

labels.symptom: Importing annotations with repeated flags turns on unrelated flags.
labels.root_cause: Flag bit values were added with sum() instead of combined with bitwise OR.

labels.symptom: On macOS, documents the app handles show a generic gray icon in Finder instead of the app's document icon.
labels.root_cause: The CFBundleDocumentTypes entry in Info.plist declares no CFBundleTypeIconFile.

labels.symptom: A visible digital signature can show only text, not a drawn, typed or image graphic.
Searching filters and the command palette miss matches with Turkish İ/ı when the case differs.
labels.root_cause: Filters used locale-free str::to_lowercase instead of case folding.

labels.symptom: Long translated labels overflow the sidebar and push its controls off-screen.
labels.root_cause: The fixed-width panel headers do not truncate long translated text.

labels.symptom: Link annotations accept infinite or NaN rectangle coordinates when added or edited.
labels.root_cause: Rectangle validation checked only the minimum size, not whether values are finite or overflow.

labels.symptom: Bare email addresses are not turned into mailto links.
labels.root_cause: Link detection only recognised http, https and www prefixes.

labels.symptom: Print ranges between page labels that contain hyphens, like A-1-A-3, are parsed wrongly.
labels.root_cause: The range parser split at the first hyphen.

labels.symptom: On Windows, opening the Print dialog or pressing Print freezes the window for seconds, and printed sheets come out small.
labels.root_cause: The printer list was queried through slow PowerShell CIM calls and jobs were spooled on the UI thread, and the output was not scaled to fill the paper.

labels.symptom: No release download is offered for Linux on riscv64.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow had no cross-compiled riscv64 Linux job.

labels.symptom: Pages with a non-default /UserUnit show the wrong physical size and wrong form font sizes.
labels.root_cause: The page /UserUnit scale was ignored.

labels.symptom: In Read mode, the side rail's Bookmarks and other pane buttons do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The right panel was drawn only when the mode was not Read.

labels.symptom: A root-confinement test fails on Windows for users who cannot create symbolic links.
labels.root_cause: The test ignored a failure to create the symbolic link and counted ordinary paths as escapes.

labels.symptom: After a document is opened, the visible page stays blank for several seconds.
labels.root_cause: The render queue let thumbnail and text-extraction work compete with the visible page raster for the render workers.

labels.symptom: Local development builds use too much disk space.
Measure snapping misses closing edges of filled shapes that have several subpaths.
labels.root_cause: Implicit closing edges were tracked only for the last open subpath.

labels.symptom: On Windows, generating the demo PDF and screenshots fails with a page-count error.
labels.root_cause: Windows verbatim \\?\ paths produced bad file URLs, and the poll accepted partial Chrome PDF writes as finished.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Kazakh.
A malformed PDF with a huge page count crashes the app instead of reporting an error.
labels.root_cause: lopdf's get_pages allocated one entry for every page in the declared /Count, and the allocation failure aborted the process.

labels.symptom: A Japanese text edit with more than 240 unique characters is refused.
labels.root_cause: All fallback glyphs had to fit in one Type 3 font, which holds at most 240 codes.

labels.symptom: Typed signatures in Cyrillic or Greek come out blank.
labels.root_cause: The script signature font covers only Latin and there was no fallback face.

labels.symptom: Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
Adding a large block of Arabic text is rejected.
labels.root_cause: An item-wide cap on generated glyph fonts limited Arabic text to 3,840 distinct glyphs.

labels.symptom: Smart card (CAC/PIV) signing identities aren't listed for signing on macOS.
labels.root_cause: The Keychain search covered only file-based keychains, not the token access group.

labels.symptom: OCR handles only Latin text, with no confidence scores or review step.
Combining more than 1,000 files is refused, and extra dropped files are silently ignored.
labels.root_cause: A fixed file-count cap stood in for a memory bound, because every source was held in memory at once.

labels.symptom: Opening a file with very deeply nested XML crashes the app with a stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: roxmltree recurses once per nesting level, so very deep XML overflows the stack and aborts the process.

labels.symptom: Optimizing a document leaves bloated ASCII-encoded stream wrappers in place.
labels.root_cause: The optimizer skipped any stream that already had a filter.

labels.symptom: Searching a huge document with a small result limit still reads every page and makes capped results look complete.
labels.root_cause: text_find extracted text from all pages before applying the limit.

labels.symptom: Building the UI crate's tests uses a lot of disk space because every integration test links as its own large binary.
labels.root_cause: Cargo auto-discovers each integration test file as a separate target, each linking the full UI/render dependency graph.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Greek.
